reviews.comment: Amazing professor and really interesting lectures. Workload is very manageable, just weekly quizzes and homework with a few lengthy but mild projects.
You should take this class, he is the GOAT. You won't regret it.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Writing intensive section, so obviously lots of papers. Dr Malecha's lectures are a bit fast, but they were still excellent. Papers were fairly graded and expectations were clear. Exams are open book and very straightforward. Very caring and passionate professor, he's also very easy to talk to if you have questions. Definitely take his class.

UWRT. i might've read like 10 pages in the required textbook. class is easy to get an A if u just do the work. he cares abt his students and is a really smart person. funny guy if u get to know him. exams were open-book due @1159. really chill. take his course for the UWRT credit if u can. u can always shoot an email if ur late too. overall 10/10
